case_digest_cards.facts_summary: The appeal concerned forgery-related offences and whether substitution of another offence, including fraud under Theft Ordinance s.16A, was available.
case_digest_cards.procedural_history: Court of Final Appeal appeal from CACC No. 230 of 2019.
issues: Whether dishonesty is an element of the fraud offence under Theft Ordinance s.16A.
How deceit and dishonesty differ in the court’s substitution analysis.
holdings: The CFA distinguished deceit and dishonesty and declined to import the Ghosh test into s.16A fraud.
The judgment records the then-current Hong Kong Ghosh dishonesty formulation by reference to Mo Yuk Ping.

ratio_principles.exact_quote: Dishonesty addresses a wholly different matter
the Ghosh test for dishonesty represents the law in Hong Kong at present
ratio_principles.scope: Candidate dishonesty-test source requiring current-treatment review.

exact_quotes: Dishonesty addresses a wholly different matter
the Ghosh test for dishonesty represents the law in Hong Kong at present
applies_when: A theft/fraud question turns on dishonesty as a mental-state concept.
distinguishable_when: The live issue is shoplifting-specific evidence, sentencing, or post-Ivey treatment not addressed by this case.

case_digest_cards.facts_summary: Magistracy appeal against conviction and sentence for theft by pickpocketing.
case_digest_cards.procedural_history: Appeal from ESCC 1886 of 2021; conviction appeal dismissed and sentence challenge rejected.
issues: Whether the conviction for theft was unsafe or unsatisfactory.
Whether the 18-month sentence was excessive in light of pickpocketing guideline authority.
holdings: The court did not disturb the magistrate’s factual evaluation and dismissed the conviction appeal.
The court treated pickpocketing theft as carrying an immediate-custody guideline, subject to aggravating features.

ratio_principles.exact_quote: an immediate custodial sentence of 12 to 15 months after trial is appropriate for a first offender
ratio_principles.scope: Pickpocketing sentencing context only; not a shoplifting liability authority.

exact_quotes: offence of theft, contrary to section 9 of the Theft Ordinance, Cap 210
The appellant was convicted of an offence of theft by pickpocketing
applies_when: A theft question needs offence/penalty context or sentencing boundary checks.
distinguishable_when: The user’s case is forgotten-payment shoplifting liability rather than pickpocketing sentence.
